item: Leaning board at the door of our apparatus is modelled as a solid wedge; the real board is open underneath. Going with: wait for the labelled test; the held-out course is not changed without your yes.
Should a track's own eval command rule be its headline (SSR's speed floor, ACP's turn rule)? Going with: no, the standard command stays the headline; variants reported beside it.

Hiking's chest camera sees toe tips to 1.66 m (you asked for 10 cm behind the toes to 2 m); the policy leans its waist back to the limit. Can the real mount pitch up about 5 degrees? Going with: leave mount and lean for now.
Pass mark for a station leg. Going with: 45 of 50 on each leg before the full route is run.
Stair tiles regenerated with the stair foot 2.5-3 m inside the tile, as an added set (your map untouched). Acting on it: built and in SSR and Hiking training.

Simulator pre-flight fails every current build. Allow launches no worse than the running build while each failure has an owner and a fix date; depth limit 5 cm for feet and sustained contacts, 10 cm for brief impacts? Going with: yes to both.
